title: Thermal management of electronics using co-located microjet nozzles and electronic elements
events: 2020-04-10 | Application filed by Jetcool Technologies Inc
abstract: An electronics assembly in which microjet nozzles are co-located with electronic elements on the same substrate or layer. This technique may be used to integrate lower power- density electronics onto an existing microjet nozzle plate to perform microjet nozzle cooling, which removes the need for separate thermal management solutions for systems that contain both high and lower power-density elements in proximity. This technique may also be used in multilayered 3D integrated electronic substrates, allowing for thin, high performing thermal management solutions in 3D integrated stackups using microjets.
claim1: 1. An electronics assembly, comprising: a first layer with a thickness; at least one active, heat-generating, electronic element disposed on or in the first layer; and at least one passageway that passes entirely through the thickness of the first layer, wherein the passageway is configured to conduct fluid therethrough, to extract heat from the at least one electronic element.

title: Direct contact fluid based cooling module
events: 2021-11-24 | Application filed by Jetcool Technologies Inc
abstract: A fluid delivery module that produces direct fluid-contact cooling of a computer processor, while mating with common processor accessory mounting specifications. Computer processors are commonly packaged and installed on printed circuit boards. The fluid module delivers cooling fluid directly to at least a surface of the processor package. The fluid module forms a fluid-tight seal against the surface of the processor package. By delivering fluid to the surface of the processor package, the module cools the computer processor. The module does not mechanically fasten to the processor. Instead, the module fastens to a variety of processor accessory mounting patterns commonly found on printed circuit boards. The printed circuit board typically carries the processor. This minimizes stress on the processor package, and allows greater modularity between different processors. In one embodiment, the fluid delivery is done with integral microjets, producing very high heat transfer cooling of the computer processor.
claim1: 1. A cooling module for a computer processor package, comprising: (a) an inlet port to admit into the cooling module a liquid coolant delivered from an external source; (b) an inlet plenum to receive and hold the liquid coolant admitted into the cooling module through the inlet port; (c) a reservoir that is bounded on one side by an upper surface of the computer processor package and bounded on an opposite side by a lower surface of the microjet nozzle plate, the reservoir being further configured so that, after mounting to the computer processor package, the reservoir will be in direct contact with the upper surface of the computer processor package; and (d) a microjet nozzle plate, disposed between the inlet plenum and the reservoir, the microjet nozzle plate defining a plurality of orifices extending from the inlet plenum to the reservoir to permit a portion of the liquid coolant held by the inlet plenum to pass out of the inlet plenum and into the reservoir, the plurality of orifices being formed to create a plurality of microjet nozzles, respectively; (e) wherein at least some of the microjet nozzles in the plurality of orifices defined by the microjet nozzle plate are arranged in a non-uniform pattern across the lower surface of the microjet nozzle plate; (f) whereby, as the portion of liquid coolant passes into the reservoir via the plurality of orifices in the microjet nozzle plate, the plurality of microjet nozzles produces a plurality of liquid coolant microjets, respectively, and directs the plurality of liquid coolant microjets to enter the reservoir in a direction that is substantially perpendicular to both the lower surface of the microjet nozzle plate and the upper surface of the computer processor package, thereby causing the plurality of liquid coolant microjets to strike the upper surface of the computer processor package in a direction that is substantially perpendicular to the upper surface of the computer processor package.

title: Jet impingement cooling for high power semiconductor devices
events: 2023-02-06 | Assigned to SEMICONDUCTOR COMPONENTS INDUSTRIES, LLC
2023-02-06 | Application filed by Semiconductor Components Industries LLC
2023-05-09 | Assigned to DEUTSCHE BANK AG NEW YORK BRANCH, AS COLLATERAL AGENT
2023-11-14 | Assigned to SEMICONDUCTOR COMPONENTS INDUSTRIES, LLC
abstract: A jet impingement cooling assembly for semiconductor devices includes a heat exchange base having an inlet chamber and an outlet chamber. An inlet connection may be in fluid connection with the inlet chamber, while an outlet connection may be in fluid connection with the outlet chamber. A jet plate may be coupled to the inlet chamber, and a jet pedestal may be formed on the jet plate and having a raised surface with a jet nozzle formed therein.
claim1: 1. A jet impingement cooling assembly for semiconductor devices, comprising: a heat exchange base having an inlet chamber and an outlet chamber sharing a bottom surface; an inlet connection in fluid connection with the inlet chamber; an outlet connection in fluid connection with the outlet chamber; a jet plate coupled to the inlet chamber and having a jet plate surface parallel to the bottom surface; a jet pedestal formed on the jet plate and having a raised surface with a jet nozzle formed therein; and a chamber divider within the heat exchange base and attached to the jet plate and to the bottom surface, with the inlet chamber being adjacent to the jet plate and a first side of the chamber divider, and the outlet chamber being adjacent to a second side of the chamber divider.

title: Jet impingement cooling with bypass fluid portion for high power semiconductor devices

abstract: A jet impingement cooling assembly for semiconductor devices includes an inlet chamber configured to receive an inlet fluid flow, and a jet plate having a plurality of jet nozzles formed therein and coupled to the inlet chamber, and positioned to direct a jet fluid portion of the inlet fluid flow from the inlet chamber through the jet nozzles. The jet impingement cooling assembly may further include an outlet chamber positioned to receive the jet fluid portion once the jet fluid portion has passed through the jet nozzles, and at least one bypass nozzle in fluid connection with the inlet chamber and configured to direct a bypass fluid portion of the inlet fluid flow into the outlet chamber with the jet fluid portion to thereby define an outlet fluid flow.

abstract: Methods for making heat transfer devices include forming a jet plate with a plurality of inclined jets set at an angular deviation from normal. A bottom plate is formed with channel walls that have ribs. The jet plate is attached to the bottom plate to form ribbed channels. The angular deviation of each inclined jet establishes a jet direction perpendicular to a long dimension of the ribbed channels.
claim1: 1. A method for forming a heat transfer device, comprising: forming a jet plate with a plurality of inclined jets set at an angular deviation from normal; forming a bottom plate with channel walls that have ribs; and attaching the jet plate to the bottom plate to form a plurality of ribbed channels, wherein the angular deviation of each inclined jet establishes a jet direction perpendicular to a long dimension of the plurality of ribbed channels.

title: Impinging jet manifold for chip cooling near edge jets
abstract: Systems and methods for chip cooling with near edge jets in a direct liquid cooled module are disclosed. One of the functions of a direct liquid cooled module is to provide cooling liquid to components located on a chip. Jet impingement directly onto the back side of a chip is one cooling method that can provide more efficient cooling. An orifice plate includes an array of small diameter holes that correspond to high velocity jet locations and large diameter holes for the insertion of tubes to connect to lower pressure cavities.

title: Cold plate device for a two-phase cooling system
events: 2018-03-29 | Application filed by International Business Machines Corp
2018-03-29 | Assigned to INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MACHINES CORPORATION
abstract: Techniques that facilitate two-phase liquid cooling of an electronic device are provided. In one example, an apparatus, such as a cold plate device, comprises a first stackable layer and a second stackable layer. The first stackable layer comprises a first channel formed within the first stackable layer. The first channel comprises a first channel width and the first channel receives a coolant fluid via an inlet port of the apparatus. The second stackable layer comprises a second channel that provides a path for the coolant fluid to flow between the first channel and an outlet port of the apparatus. A width of the second channel increases along a flow direction of the coolant fluid that flows between the inlet port and the outlet port.
claim1: 1. An apparatus, comprising: a first stackable layer that comprises a first channel formed within the first stackable layer, wherein the first channel comprises a first channel width, and wherein the first channel receives a coolant fluid via an inlet port of the apparatus; and a second stackable layer that comprises a second channel that provides a path for the coolant fluid to flow between the first channel and an outlet port of the apparatus, wherein a width of the second channel increases along a flow direction of the coolant fluid that flows between the inlet port and the outlet port, wherein the first channel and the second channel form a set of expanding channels for the apparatus, and wherein a height of the set of expanding channels and a width of the set of expanding channels increases along a flow direction of the coolant fluid through the apparatus.

title: Cold plate architecture for liquid cooling of devices
abstract: Examples described herein relate to a cold plate. In some examples, the cold plate includes a surface with fins and at least two channels, wherein a first channel is shaped with a first opening extending towards the surface, a second opening proximate and across a first fin attached to the surface, and a third opening from the surface and extending away from the surface. In some examples, when a fluid is provided to the first opening, the first opening directs the fluid towards the surface, the second opening directs the fluid across the first fin, and the third opening directs the fluid away from the surface. In some examples, the second opening comprises split openings around opposite sides of the first fin.

title: Intelligent cold plate system with active and passive features for a datacenter cooling system
abstract: Systems and methods for cooling a datacenter are disclosed. In at least one embodiment, a cold plate has microchannels and a heat pipe to support a first fluid in an active mode of operation of a cold plate that uses microchannels, and to support a second fluid in a passive mode of operation of a cold plate that uses a heat pipe.
claim1: 1 . A datacenter cooling system, comprising: a cold plate comprising microchannels within a first cavity of the cold plate and a heat pipe within a second cavity of the cold plate, the microchannels to support at least a first fluid in an active mode of operation of the cold plate, the first fluid to flow through the microchannels by action of at least one flow controller at a server manifold, and the heat pipe to support a second fluid in a passive mode of operation of the cold plate, the second fluid to circulate in the heat pipe by differential temperature and capillary actions between an evaporator section and a condenser section of the heat pipe, wherein the microchannels include a first microchannel forming a first coolant loop circulating a third fluid directly from the server manifold to the cold plate, and a second microchannel forming at least part of a second coolant loop circulating the first fluid from an adjacent cold plate to the cold plate; and a processor to use one or more neural networks to cause the at least one flow controller to selectively enable the active mode including the second coolant loop circulating the first fluid in the microchannels within the cold plate alongside the passive mode of circulating the second fluid inside the heat pipe of the cold plate based, at least in part, on sensor inputs from one or more sensors indicating a thermal condition of the second fluid, wherein both the active mode and the passive mode are operated when the active mode is selectively enabled, wherein the first coolant loop circulating the third fluid directly from the server manifold into the cold plate is further selectively enabled based on a cooling condition of the second coolant loop circulating the first fluid.

title: Direct liquid micro jet (dlmj) structures for addressing thermal performance at limited flow rate conditions
abstract: A heat exchange module, comprising an array of microchannels, where the array of microchannels extends in a first direction, and are separated from one another by a first sidewall. The array of microchannels is over a cold plate. A first array of fluid distribution channels is stacked over the array of microchannels and extend in a second direction that is substantially orthogonal to the first direction. The first array of fluid distribution channels extends from the first manifold and terminate between a first manifold and a second manifold. A second array of fluid distribution channels is stacked over the array of microchannels. The first array of fluid distribution channels and the second array of the fluid distribution channels are fluidically coupled to the microchannel array. A wall extends into the microchannel array below a second sidewall separating ones of the first array and ones of the second array of fluid distribution channels.
claim1: 1 . A heat exchange module, comprising: an array of microchannels, wherein ones of the array of microchannels extend in a first direction, and are separated from one another by a first sidewall, the array of microchannels is over a cold plate; a first manifold and a second manifold; a first array of fluid distribution channels stacked over the array of microchannels and extending in a second direction that is substantially orthogonal to the first direction, wherein the first array of fluid distribution channels extends from the first manifold and terminate between the first manifold and the second manifold; a second array of fluid distribution channels stacked over the array of microchannels and parallel to the first array, wherein the second array extends from the second manifold and terminate between the first manifold and the second manifold, and wherein the first array is interleaved with the second array; wherein the first array of fluid distribution channels and the second array of the fluid distribution channels are fluidically coupled to the microchannel array, wherein a wall extends into the microchannel array below a second sidewall separating ones of the first array and ones of the second array of fluid distribution channels.

title: Centrifugal micro-channel structure for CPU heat dissipation and use method thereof
assignee_original: Suzhou Inspur Intelligent Technology Co Ltd
assignee_current: Suzhou Metabrain Intelligent Technology Co Ltd
events: 2021-08-31 | Application filed by Suzhou Inspur Intelligent Technology Co Ltd
abstract: Abstract Translated from Chinese 本发明公开一种用于CPU散热的离心微通道结构及其使用方法，属于CPU散热技术领域，包括基板和散热壳体，散热壳体侧面呈阿基米德曲线形状；散热壳体下面环形阵列设有若干离心肋片，相邻离心肋片间形成离心通道；离心肋片内沿包围形成与CPU中心对应喷射空间，其外沿与散热壳体侧面之间形成导流通道；导流通道末端设有出口；散热壳体上面设有喷嘴，喷嘴向喷射空间内喷射冷却液，形成单相淹没射流强化传热结构，且离心结构的离心通道和阿基米德曲线特征的导流侧板，使在中心位置的喷射空间换热能力最强，并沿径向离心降低；与CPU的热流密度分布完全一致，实现CPU最佳的散热均温性；整体结构简单，使用便捷，实用性好。 The invention discloses a centrifugal micro-channel structure for CPU heat dissipation and a method of using the same, belonging to the technical field of CPU heat dissipation. The invention includes a substrate and a heat dissipation shell. There are several centrifugal fins, and a centrifugal channel is formed between adjacent centrifugal fins; the inner edge of the centrifugal fins forms a spray space corresponding to the center of the CPU, and a guide channel is formed between the outer edge and the side of the heat dissipation shell; the end of the guide channel There is an outlet; there is a nozzle on the heat dissipation shell, and the nozzle sprays the cooling liquid into the spray space to form a single-phase submerged jet to strengthen the heat transfer structure, and the centrifugal channel of the centrifugal structure and the deflector side plate with the characteristics of Archimedes curve, The heat transfer capacity of the jet space at the center position is the strongest, and the centrifugal reduction along the radial direction is completely consistent with the heat flux density distribution of the CPU, so as to achieve the best heat dissipation uniformity of the CPU; the overall structure is simple, easy to use, and good practicability.
claim1: 1. The centrifugal micro-channel structure for CPU heat dissipation is characterized by comprising a substrate (1) attached to a CPU and a heat dissipation shell (2) arranged on the substrate (1), wherein the side surface of the heat dissipation shell (2) is in an Archimedes curve shape; a plurality of centrifugal fins (3) are annularly arrayed on one side, close to the base plate (1), of the heat dissipation shell (2), and a centrifugal channel is formed between every two adjacent centrifugal fins (3); the inner edges of the centrifugal ribs (3) surround to form an injection space corresponding to the center of the CPU, and a flow guide channel is formed between the outer edge of the centrifugal rib and the side surface of the heat dissipation shell (2); the tail end of the flow guide channel is provided with an outlet (25); and a plurality of nozzles (24) are arranged on one side of the heat dissipation shell (2) far away from the substrate (1), and the nozzles (24) spray cooling liquid into the spraying space.

title: A method and device for constructing a liquid-cooled radiator microchannel with integrated bypass control
assignee_original: Guangdong Lanrui Technology Group Co ltd
assignee_current: Guangdong Lanrui Technology Group Co ltd
events: 2025-08-11 | Application filed by Guangdong Lanrui Technology Group Co ltd
abstract: The application discloses a method and a device for constructing a liquid cooling radiator microchannel integrating bypass control, which are used for solving the problem of energy waste caused by fixing a high-flow-resistance microchannel. The method comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional geometric model of the liquid cooling radiator, wherein the three-dimensional geometric model comprises a main channel for processing peak heat load working conditions, a bypass channel for processing low heat load working conditions and an SMA micro-actuator arranged in the bypass channel, defining a fluid domain, a solid domain and an actuator domain respectively, configuring an SMA constitutive model for describing the relationship of temperature, stress and phase change for the actuator domain, establishing a two-way coupling relationship among the fluid domain, the solid domain and the actuator domain according to the SMA constitutive model to form a digital twin model, applying simulated heat load which changes along with time to the digital twin model to obtain simulation performance parameters of the liquid cooling radiator under dynamic working conditions, and carrying out iterative optimization on target design parameters according to the simulation performance parameters to obtain target design parameters.
claim1: 1. The method for constructing the liquid cooling radiator micro-channel integrating bypass control is characterized by comprising the following steps of: Establishing a three-dimensional geometric model of the liquid cooling radiator, wherein the three-dimensional geometric model comprises a main channel for processing peak heat load working conditions, a bypass channel for processing low heat load working conditions and an SMA micro-actuator arranged in the bypass channel; performing mesh subdivision processing for finite element numerical simulation on the three-dimensional geometric model to obtain a mesh model; the method comprises the steps of respectively defining a fluid domain, a solid domain and an actuator domain in the grid model corresponding to cooling fluid, a heat dissipation substrate and the SMA micro-actuator of the liquid cooling radiator, and configuring an SMA constitutive model for describing the relationship of temperature, stress and phase change for the actuator domain; Establishing a two-way coupling relation among the fluid domain, the solid domain and the actuator domain according to the SMA constitutive model to form a digital twin model, wherein the two-way coupling relation comprises conjugate heat transfer coupling, thermal deformation coupling and fluid-solid coupling; Applying a simulated thermal load which changes along with time to the digital twin model to obtain simulation performance parameters of the liquid cooling radiator under a dynamic working condition; and carrying out iterative optimization on target design parameters according to the simulation performance parameters to obtain target design parameters, wherein the target design parameters comprise at least one of geometric dimensions, shapes, anchor point positions and material phase change activation temperatures of the SMA micro-actuator.
